intro.title: One class. One pause. A new way to experience Buenos Aires.
intro.lead: Visiting Buenos Aires or planning your trip?
body: Between cafés, restaurants, shopping, long walks and late porteño nights, make room for a moment that's just for you.
At Studio124 we invite you to a Reformer Pilates experience in a warm, thoughtfully designed boutique space, right in the heart of Palermo Soho.
intro.note: No membership needed, and you don't have to live in the city. Just book a drop-in class.

items.question: What should I wear?
items.answer: Comfortable clothing, ideally close-fitting. Please avoid anything with zippers or metal details.

items.question: Is it OK if I've never done Pilates?
items.answer: Yes. With a maximum of {max} people per class, we can guide you closely and adapt every exercise to your level.

items.question: What is the cancellation policy?
items.answer: You can reschedule your class to another day or time with at least {hours} hours' notice. Classes are non-refundable.

items.question: Can I train with an injury?
items.answer: Yes, as long as you're not in acute pain and your doctor has cleared you. Let us know before class so we can adapt the exercises.

items.question: Is Pilates a rehabilitation method?
items.answer: No. Pilates helps prevent injuries and improve mobility, but it doesn't replace medical rehabilitation.

items.question: Can I do Pilates while pregnant?
items.answer: Absolutely, as long as your OB-GYN has given you the OK. Ideally, start from the third month onward.

items.question: Is there a minimum age?
items.answer: Yes: from age {age} and up, you're more than welcome!

items.question: Is Pilates just for women?
items.answer: Not at all! It's a complete workout designed for anyone, regardless of gender.
